# FerroFED

> FerroFED is a pure-Rust openEHR federation gateway, one of the FerroHEALTH family. It is a transparent ITS-REST intermediary: a client sends it an ordinary AQL query and never learns it was federated. The gateway resolves the patient outside AQL through an identifier cross-reference service, sends standard AQL to each node scoped to that node's own EHR id, so no directly identifying identifier travels in a dispatched query, merges the answers with each node's provenance, and routes follow-up reads and writes to the owning CDR. It holds no clinical data of its own. It implements the openEHR Federation Working Group's Federation Tier with AQL specification, a release candidate at v0.9.0. The project is in its design phase: there is no Cargo workspace, no release, and no binary yet. FerroFED ships no AI: no model is trained, embedded, or called at request time. AI coding assistance is used to build it, under human review.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what FerroFED is, and the licence.
- [Working discipline](CLAUDE.md): the engineering rules for changing the code, the status, and the repo map.
- [Vendored specifications](docs/specs/): the Federation Tier specification and its reference implementation, each with its provenance.

## The specification

- [Federation Tier with AQL (rendered)](https://syntaric.github.io/openehr-federation-spec/): the governing text.
- [Specification source](https://github.com/syntaric/openehr-federation-spec): the AsciiDoc pages, the two JSON Schemas, the conformance points.
- [Reference implementation](https://github.com/syntaric/openehr-federation-ref): prior art and evidence, never an oracle.

## Rules (`.claude/rules/`)

- [spec-adherence.md](.claude/rules/spec-adherence.md): the specifications are the oracle; strictness and citation.
- [codegen.md](.claude/rules/codegen.md): what is generated and what is hand-written; never hand-edit a `// @generated` file.
- [reliability.md](.claude/rules/reliability.md): the machine-enforced safety rules.
- [rust-style.md](.claude/rules/rust-style.md): idiomatic Rust style and import discipline.
- [testing.md](.claude/rules/testing.md): test discipline; never weaken a test to make a build pass.
- [comments.md](.claude/rules/comments.md): comment budgets (RFC 505 and RFC 1574).
- [writing-style.md](.claude/rules/writing-style.md): the prose rules for all human-facing text.
- [vendored-inputs.md](.claude/rules/vendored-inputs.md): external material enters through a committed fetch script, verbatim, with provenance.
- [ci-cd.md](.claude/rules/ci-cd.md): workflow security and the supply-chain discipline.
- [ai-code-review.md](.claude/rules/ai-code-review.md): SonarQube Cloud and CodeQL are advisory, never authority.
- [issue-workflow.md](.claude/rules/issue-workflow.md): the GitHub Issues work loop.
